summary: Security update 5.2.2 for Multi-Linux Manager Server
details:
This update fixes the following issues:

Release Notes Highlights:

- Update to SUSE Multi-Linux Manager 5.2.2
  * SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 16.1 and openSUSE Leap 16.1
  * Support for SLE 16 / Agama-Based Installer
  * Activation keys are deleted with their base channel
  * Enhanced SCAP Auditing Integration now generally available
  * Improved Transactional System Management
  * SPDX SBOM for KIWI OS Images
  * Action Descriptions
  * API Version Bumped to 30

    denylist) (bsc#1278008)

Other changes:

- Version 5.2.25-0
  * Fix regex in Ubuntu OVAL parser to match current Canonical comment wording
  * Log warning when non-empty OVAL definitions yield 0 vulnerable packages
- Version 5.2.24-0
  * Allow saving kickstart profiles without the deprecated auth command (bsc#1286150)
  * Clarify cloned patch reuse in the 'channel.software.clone' and 'errata.clone*' API documentation (bsc#1282231)
- Version 5.2.23-0
  * Change API version to 30
  * Add the java.kickstart_url_scheme property to enable the https protocol for autoinstallation (bsc#1271394)
  * Change color of languages and remove spaces in user creation page
  * Add migration paths from SLES4SAP 15SP7 to SLES4SAP 16.0
    (bsc#1286315)
  * Make OpenSCAP scan scheduling generally available
  * Remove scheduleXccdfScan* and scheduleBetaXccdfScan* methods
    from `system.scap`
  * Fixed inconsistent SSM and Convert to Proxy buttons state on the System Details tabs. (bsc#1268632)
  * Fixed image status icon to reflect failed image inspections. (bsc#1255090)
  * Removed 'Go to OS image directory listing' link
    from Images page. (bsc#1251867)
  * Remove activation keys when a base channel is deleted
    (bsc#1233592)
  * Fix duplicate UI entries in rhel10-like minion package
    upgrades (bsc#1262234)
  * Set default checksum type for new UI channels to sha256
    (bsc#1269011)
  * Fix correct assignment of peripheral entitlement (bsc#1269086)
  * Fix CLM promotion race by publishing alignment after commit
    (bsc#1275315)
  * Fix Ansible path API descriptions
  * Avoid autofocus warnings during PJAX navigation.
  * Align kickstart script ranking handler arguments.
  * Fix accessibility markup for mirror credential dialogs.
  * Display a warning only for eligible subscriptions (bsc#1284284)
  * Use the correct field for ordering ErrataFile (bsc#1279463)
  * Prefer the field allbinaries over binaries when present in an
    Ubuntu erratum (bsc#1280946)
  * Accept both string and array of string as values for the cves
    field in Ubuntu erratas (bsc#1280946,
    gh#uyuni-project/uyuni#12544)
  * Process Ubuntu erratas with no binaries (bsc#1280946)
  * Fix the OVAL based CVE audit for Debian systems, whose OS name
    reported by Salt is 'Debian GNU/Linux'
  * Commit transaction in syncChannel when repo-sync is running for
    the same channel to prevent possible deadlocks (bsc#1274884)
  * Fix race condition when adding or removing a server to or from
    an activation key (bsc#1268744)
  * Handle distupgrade to SLE16 for SSH minions (bsc#1268463)
  * Add migration path for EL10 products
  * Enable product migrations to 16.1 for SLES, SLES for SAP and SLE-RT
  * Refactor ClmChannelDiff task to use a Queue. With this
    the tasks can be executed in parallel and the hibernate
    cache is staying smaller as the results are faster commited.
    This should prevent blocking other tasks (bsc#1273021)
  * Fix manage channel packages UI
  * Collect KIWI SPDX SBOMs with built OS images
  * Include CVEs column in the CSV export of the 'Patches Relevant to
    Your Systems' page
  * Stop forcing password-based SAML authentication by default; the
    requested AuthnContext defaults shipped in the SSO config are now
    commented out so the IdP can pick the appropriate authentication
    method (FIDO2, Yubikey, Windows Hello) with strict SAML clients
    such as Microsoft Edge
  * Add autoinstallation support for SLE16
  * Add support for setting action description via webUI and API
  * Fix CLM stuck in building by waiting for
    full DB commit in ActionExecutor
  * Remove OVAL section in errata details (bsc#1278406)
  * Optimize cloned channel sync queries in
    `Errata_queries.xml` to avoid nested loops (bsc#1273071)
  * Only delete outdated data during oval sync instead of the
    entire data set
  * Make proxy certs optional (bsc#1265630)
  * Remove traditional stack leftover in dist migration
    and allow the API to proceed product migration
    even if there are outstanding management
    stack updates (bsc#1275215)
  * Fix ISE when changing the SSL set of an existing repository
    (bsc#1281341)
  * Fix Channel/Errata/Package bidirectional relationship mappings
  * Improve error handling/reporting for failed salt functions
  * Add a fallback errata ID for Ubuntu errata without identification
  * Fix CLM not propagating new AppStream module
    versions to cloned channels (bsc#1254201)
  * Fix virtual instance refresh for mixed SSH and regular
    minions (bsc#1254316)
  * Improve CVE audit performance to avoid timeouts with many systems
    (bsc#1276449)
  * Batch OVAL package lookups during CVE audits
    (bsc#1276449)
  * Fix NPE on repository metadata generation (bsc#1277592)
  * Speed up loading package data for repodata generation by
    avoiding a full scan of the checksum table (bsc#1286091)
  * Cache the public methods of classes used to fill query results
    to reduce CPU usage
  * Do not execute select queries twice when no IN clause is used
  * Commit and close the database transaction after connecting to
    the Salt event bus to not block database maintenance
  * Add transactional action progress tracking and snapshot refresh
    support
  * Support live execution through direct_call on transactional
    systems
  * Add transactional execution options for Apply States and remote
    commands
  * Support highstate continuation and transactional formula
    workflows, including recurring formula actions
  * Prefer the Salt transactional grain when identifying
    transactional systems
  * Report in system.getEventHistory and system.getEventDetails
    whether an action is waiting for a reboot
  * Periodically flush and clear the session for Errata Advisory
    (bsc#1277714)

How to apply this update:

1. Log in as root user to the SUSE Multi-Linux Manager Server.
2. Upgrade mgradm and mgrctl.
3. If you are in a disconnected environment, upgrade the image packages.
4. Reboot the system.
5. Run 'mgradm upgrade podman' which will use the default image tags.
